# Morning Briefing – Night 11 ## 1️⃣ **High‑Priority Ablation (Day‑19 Deadline)** | Item | Action | Deadline | |------|--------|----------| | **Rewrite‑vs‑Append Benchmark**
(MemGPT + ICLR submission) | Allocate **2400 H100 GPU‑hours** to run a controlled ablation comparing *structured rewrite* vs *naïve append* (including a MemGPT‑style virtual‑context paging baseline). | **Day‑19** (≥ 5 days before \#214) | | **Benchmark Execution Slot** | Book a dedicated **30‑min window (Thu 14:00)** in the recurring lab meeting to run quick sanity checks and log results. | **Today** (confirm slot) | | **Reviewer 2 Response Draft** | Draft a concise reply addressing isolation of rewrite benefits, citing planned ablation. | **Today** (send by end‑day) | *Closest‑action items:* - **Allocate GPU quota** → `d361c7aa` has approved 2400 H100 GPU‑hrs; authorize usage. - **Set up MemGPT paging baseline** → copy code from `8e3bb063`; integrate with ICLR training loop. - **Schedule Thursday meeting slot** → send calendar invite. **Draft response to Reviewer 2:** > *“We acknowledge Reviewer 2’s concern regarding the source of performance gains… We will conduct a rewrite‑vs‑append ablation, employing a MemGPT‑style virtual‑context paging baseline and an append‑only baseline with periodic consolidation (per arXiv 2105.01073). Results will be incorporated by the day‑19 deadline.”* ## 2️⃣ **Lab & Workshop Updates** | Task | Status | Notes | |------|--------|-------| | **Weekly Lab Meeting** | ✔️ *Moved* | Wed 11:00 starts next week (update calendar). | | **Workshop Paper (agent‑memory benchmarks)** | ⚠️ *Drafting* | Follow‑up on outline (303fb425); aim to finish first draft by mid‑week. | | **Co‑author Workshop (d.okafor)** | ⚡ *Low urgency* | Continue informal check‑ins. | ## 3️⃣ **Low‑Priority: Rest & Reading** - Save time on **MemGPT** reading; already noted for future integration. ## Overnight Idea > *Combining MemGPT’s virtual‑context paging with periodic consolidation (from the arXiv paper) could reduce cross‑fact interference and boost downstream recall beyond rewrite alone. We’ll monitor if this hybrid approach yields measurable gains during the upcoming ablation run.* ---
